verdict.rationale: Evidence covers payouts, balances, dashboards, and onboarding but nowhere addresses fund segregation from Finix's own accounts, custody structure, or whether held balances earn yield. Only tangential mention is topping up a 'Finix balance' via ACH/wire (finix-docs-15), which doesn't clarify custody or yield questions. missing for 10: any documentation on fund segregation/safeguarding, custodial account structure, or interest/yield on held balances.
